type.name: Status
type.doc: Defines common return status codes. Compare against {::Ok} for success.

value.name: Ok
value.doc: Operation succeeded.

value.name: Timeout
value.doc: Operation timed out.

value.name: Partial
value.doc: Operation partially succeeded.

value.name: InvalidArgument
value.doc: One or more arguments, or parts of arguments passed to the function were incorrect.

value.name: OutOfHostMemory
value.doc: There is no more host memory available.

value.name: OutOfDeviceMemory
value.doc: There is no more device memory available.

value.name: DeviceLost
value.doc: Device driver was forcefully stopped.

value.name: Occluded
value.doc: Swap chain presentation was not visible to the user. Rendering is too fast.

value.name: ValidationFailed
value.doc: A validation layer found an error.

value.name: Fail
value.doc: Operation failed as expected.

value.name: Error
value.doc: Operation failed.

type.name: DataFormat
type.doc: Data format for data. Used as a template for data in several cases. Can be used to describe: - Vertex buffer data format - Texture data format - Render target data format - Depth stencil data format

value.name: Unknown
value.doc: Unknown format.

value.name: RGBA32Float

value.name: RGBA32Uint
value.doc: 32 bit per channel RGBA format. A four-component, 128-bit unsigned integer format that has a 32-bit R component in bytes 0..3, a 32-bit G component in bytes 4..7, a 32-bit B component in bytes 8..11, a 32-bit A component in bytes 12..15.

value.name: RGBA32Sint
value.doc: 32 bit per channel RGBA format. A four-component, 128-bit signed integer format that has a 32-bit R component in bytes 0..3, a 32-bit G component in bytes 4..7, a 32-bit B component in bytes 8..11, a 32-bit A component in bytes 12..15.

value.name: RGB32Float
value.doc: 32 bit per channel RGB format. A three-component, 96-bit signed floating-point format that has a 32-bit R component in bytes 0..3, a 32-bit G component in bytes 4..7, a 32-bit B component in bytes 8..11.

value.name: RGB32Uint
value.doc: 32 bit per channel RGB format. A three-component, 96-bit unsigned integer format that has a 32-bit R component in bytes 0..3, a 32-bit G component in bytes 4..7, a 32-bit B component in bytes 8..11.

value.name: RGB32Sint

value.name: RGBA16Float
value.doc: 16 bit per channel RGBA format. A four-component, 64-bit signed floating-point format that has a 16-bit R component in bytes 0..1, a 16-bit G component in bytes 2..3, a 16-bit B component in bytes 4..5, a 16-bit A component in bytes 6..7.

value.name: RGBA16Unorm
value.doc: 16 bit per channel RGBA format. A four-component, 64-bit unsigned normalized format that has a 16-bit R component in bytes 0..1, a 16-bit G component in bytes 2..3, a 16-bit B component in bytes 4..5, a 16-bit A component in bytes 6..7.

value.name: RGBA16Uint
value.doc: 16 bit per channel RGBA format. A four-component, 64-bit unsigned integer format that has a 16-bit R component in bytes 0..1, a 16-bit G component in bytes 2..3, a 16-bit B component in bytes 4..5, a 16-bit A component in bytes 6..7.

value.name: RGBA16Snorm

value.name: RGBA16Sint
value.doc: 16 bit per channel RGBA format. A four-component, 64-bit signed integer format that has a 16-bit R component in bytes 0..1, a 16-bit G component in bytes 2..3, a 16-bit B component in bytes 4..5, a 16-bit A component in bytes 6..7.

value.name: RG32Float
value.doc: 32 bit per channel RG format. A two-component, 64-bit signed floating-point format that has a 32-bit R component in bytes 0..3, a 32-bit G component in bytes 4..7.

value.name: RG32Uint
value.doc: 32 bit per channel RG format. A two-component, 64-bit unsigned integer format that has a 32-bit R component in bytes 0..3, a 32-bit G component in bytes 4..7.

value.name: RG32Sint
value.doc: 32 bit per channel RG format. A two-component, 64-bit signed integer format that has a 32-bit R component in bytes 0..3, a 32-bit G component in bytes 4..7.

value.name: D32FloatS8Uint
value.doc: 32 bit depth, 8 bit stencil format. A combined depth/stencil format with a 32-bit depth component in bytes 0..3 and an 8-bit stencil component in bytes 4..4.

value.name: RGB10A2Unorm
value.doc: 10 bit per channel RGB format with 2 bit alpha. A four-component, 32-bit unsigned normalized format that has a 10-bit R component in bits 0..9, a 10-bit G component in bits 10..19, a 10-bit B component in bits 20..29, a 2-bit A component in bits 30..31.

value.name: RGB10A2Uint

value.name: RG11B10Float

value.name: RGBA8Unorm
value.doc: 8 bit per channel RGBA format. A four-component, 32-bit unsigned normalized format that has an 8-bit R component in bytes 0..0, an 8-bit G component in bytes 1..1, an 8-bit B component in bytes 2..2, an 8-bit A component in bytes 3..3.

value.name: RGBA8Uint

value.name: RGBA8Snorm

value.name: RGBA8Sint
value.doc: 8 bit per channel RGBA format. A four-component, 32-bit signed integer format that has an 8-bit R component in bytes 0..0, an 8-bit G component in bytes 1..1, an 8-bit B component in bytes 2..2, an 8-bit A component in bytes 3..3.

value.name: RG16Float

value.name: RG16Unorm
value.doc: 16 bit per channel RG format. A two-component, 32-bit unsigned normalized format that has a 16-bit R component in bytes 0..1, a 16-bit G component in bytes 2..3.

value.name: RG16Uint
value.doc: 16 bit per channel RG format. A two-component, 32-bit unsigned integer format that has a 16-bit R component in bytes 0..1, a 16-bit G component in bytes 2..3.

value.name: RG16Snorm
value.doc: 16 bit per channel RG format. A two-component, 32-bit signed normalized format that has a 16-bit R component in bytes 0..1, a 16-bit G component in bytes 2..3.

value.name: RG16Sint
value.doc: 16 bit per channel RG format. A two-component, 32-bit signed integer format that has a 16-bit R component in bytes 0..1, a 16-bit G component in bytes 2..3.

value.name: D32Float
value.doc: 32 bit depth format. A 32-bit depth format supporting 32-bit floating-point depth values.

value.name: R32Float

value.name: RG8Unorm

value.name: RG8Uint
value.doc: 8 bit per channel RG format. A two-component, 16-bit unsigned integer format that has an 8-bit R component in bytes 0..0, an 8-bit G component in bytes 1..1.

value.name: RG8Snorm
value.doc: 8 bit per channel RG format. A two-component, 16-bit signed normalized format that has an 8-bit R component in bytes 0..0, an 8-bit G component in bytes 1..1.

value.name: RG8Sint
value.doc: 8 bit per channel RG format. A two-component, 16-bit signed integer format that has an 8-bit R component in bytes 0..0, an 8-bit G component in bytes 1..1.

value.name: R16Float
value.doc: 16 bit per channel R format. A one-component, 16-bit signed floating-point format that has a 16-bit R component in bytes 0..1.

value.name: D16Unorm
value.doc: 16 bit depth format. A 16-bit depth format supporting 16-bit unsigned normalized depth values.

value.name: R16Unorm
value.doc: 16 bit per channel R format. A one-component, 16-bit unsigned normalized format that has a 16-bit R component in bytes 0..1.

value.name: R16Uint
value.doc: 16 bit per channel R format. A one-component, 16-bit unsigned integer format that has a 16-bit R component in bytes 0..1.

value.name: R16Snorm

value.name: BC1RGBAUnorm
value.doc: BC1/DXT1 compressed format. A four-component, block-compressed format where each 64-bit compressed texel block encodes a 4×4 rectangle of unsigned normalized RGB texel data, and provides 1 bit of alpha.

value.name: BC1RGBAUnormSrgb
value.doc: BC1/DXT1 compressed format. A four-component, block-compressed format where each 64-bit compressed texel block encodes a 4×4 rectangle of unsigned normalized RGB texel data with sRGB nonlinear encoding, and provides 1 bit of alpha.

value.name: BC2RGBAUnorm
value.doc: BC2/DXT3 compressed format. A four-component, block-compressed format where each 128-bit compressed texel block encodes a 4×4 rectangle of unsigned normalized RGBA texel data with the first 64 bits encoding alpha values followed by 64 bits encoding RGB values

value.name: BC2RGBAUnormSrgb
value.doc: BC2/DXT3 compressed format. A four-component, block-compressed format where each 128-bit compressed texel block encodes a 4×4 rectangle of unsigned normalized RGBA texel data with sRGB nonlinear encoding with the first 64 bits encoding alpha values followed by 64 bits encoding RGB values

value.name: BC3RGBAUnorm

value.name: BC3RGBAUnormSrgb
value.doc: BC3/DXT5 compressed format. value.name: BGRA8Unorm

value.name: BGRA8UnormSrgb

value.name: BC6HSfloat16
value.doc: BC6H compressed format. A three-component, block-compressed format where each 128-bit compressed texel block encodes a 4×4 rectangle of signed floating-point RGB texel data

value.doc: BC7 compressed format. A four-component, block-compressed format where each 128-bit compressed texel block encodes a 4×4 rectangle of unsigned normalized RGBA texel data

value.doc: Texture is 1D array of data. Behaves similarly to Buffer.

value.doc: Texture is an array of 1D data.

type.name: AdapterPreference
type.doc: Orders the adapters according to preference using builtin heuristics of underlying APIs. For DirectX 12, this translates directly to `DXGI_GPU_PREFERENCE`. For Vulkan, sorting is based on `VkPhysicalDeviceType` heuristics.

value.name: None
value.doc: No particular preference, list adapters in system devised order.

value.name: MinConsumption
value.doc: List the adapters from low power consumption to high. DirectX 12: Integrated, Discrete, External, Software. Vulkan: Integrated GPU, Discrete GPU, Virtual GPU, CPU.

value.name: Performance
value.doc: List the adapters from high performance to low. DirectX 12: External, Discrete, Integrated, Software. Vulkan: Discrete GPU, Integrated GPU, Virtual GPU, CPU.

type.name: Severity
type.doc: Defines severity levels for logging and debugging messages.

value.name: Verbose
value.doc: Verbose level messages, typically used for detailed debugging information.

value.name: Info
value.doc: Informational messages that highlight the progress of the application.

value.name: Warning
value.doc: Potentially harmful situations that warrant attention but do not prevent normal operation.

value.name: Error
value.doc: Error events that might still allow the application to continue running.

value.name: Fatal
value.doc: Severe error events that will presumably lead the application to abort.

type.name: CommandQueueType
type.doc: Defines types of command queues that can be created on the device. Each type corresponds to a specific kind of workload that the GPU can handle.

value.name: Graphics
value.doc: Command queue for graphics operations, including rendering and compute tasks.

value.name: Compute
value.doc: Command queue dedicated to compute operations, optimized for parallel processing tasks.

value.name: Transfer
value.doc: Command queue for data transfer operations, such as copying resources between buffers and images.

value.name: VideoDecode
value.doc: Command queue for video decoding operations.

value.name: VideoEncode
value.doc: Command queue for video encoding operations.

value.name: Count
value.doc: Number of command queue types available.

type.name: CommandQueuePriority
type.doc: Global queue priority. Higher priority queues get more GPU time, but may cause performance issues if overused.

value.name: Normal
value.doc: Normal queue priority.

value.name: High
value.doc: High queue priority.

value.name: Realtime
value.doc: Global realtime queue priority. Requires special GPU support and may cause performance issues if used on unsupported hardware.

type.name: PipelineType
type.doc: Defines types of pipelines that can be created on the device. Each type corresponds to a specific kind of workload that the GPU can handle.

value.name: Graphics
value.doc: Pipeline for graphics operations, including rendering tasks.

value.name: Compute
value.doc: Pipeline dedicated to compute operations, optimized for parallel processing tasks.

value.name: RayTracing
value.doc: Pipeline for ray tracing operations, optimized for ray tracing workloads.

value.name: None
value.doc: No comparison.

value.doc: Always fail the comparison.

value.name: Less
